content.text: Eight-second continuous live-action historical film, full-frame16:9. Single reference locks the same Guan Yu actor, dark green battle robe, armor and FULL LENGTH guandao with red tassel, river wetland at dusk. Start medium-wide full body with complete pole weapon. Guan Yu stands exhausted, still upright. After two seconds his right grip slackens, heavy weapon tilts under gravity. Camera tilts down following the intact long shaft and blade into the damp earth; actor's upper body leaves the frame naturally. Blade and shaft hit ground, tassel settles a beat later. The actor's feet may remain at frame edge but no body collapse, no wound. No sword shortening or multiplying, no floating shaft, no magically detached blade. Real weight, normal speed. Wind, fabric, subtle tired breathing, one heavy earthy metal impact and tassel rustle. No words, no music, no chanting, no subtitles, no borders.
